question: What nature and boon are attributed to the syllable haṃ?
premises: It is described as having the form of desire
It is said to give enjoyment of the kalarī kingdom
inference: The syllable haṃ has the form of desire and grants enjoyment of the kalarī kingdom.
uncertainties: The term kalarī is retained as a technical name.
plain_english: Haṃ is of the nature of desire and gives enjoyment of the kalarī kingdom.
